title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel network subscribers in Brazil.
backbase_rationale: No direct impact on Backbase services at this time.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Removal of the Send to Coworker action from the Domain Authentication flow may affect users who previously relied on email-based DNS record updates.
backbase_rationale: To reduce low-usage complexity and improve security in DNS record management.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK's minimum Android SDK requirement increased to 24, requiring project SDK adjustments.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its Android app's minSdk setting to match the SDK's requirement.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The SDK now includes accessibility updates to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA guidelines, enhancing compliance.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should evaluate whether the new accessibility features impact its application and ensure compliance with accessibility standards.
